hints.title: Subproblem Splitting and Swapping
hints.text: A scramble partition splits strings into two non-empty pieces, which may remain in original order or be swapped.

hints.title: Character Multiset Pruning
hints.text: Before recursive partitioning, verify that character frequency counts match between the two candidate substrings.

hints.title: Memoized Substring Partitioning
hints.text: Cache results for pairs of substrings. If strings are equal, return true. If sorted character counts differ, return false. Test every split point i: check if left matches left and right matches right, or if swapped left matches right and right matches left.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal interval dynamic programming with character frequency pruning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching without memoization and frequency filtering explores exponential states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing pairs of equal-length substrings reduces time to polynomial polynomial order.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prune branches with mismatched character frequencies before recursing across partition lengths.
